summary: Tokyo Lifestyle Co., Ltd., a Japanese retail operator filing as a foreign private issuer on Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a current report on Form 8-K), disclosed that its board approved on September 24, 2026 a cash dividend of JPY1.432 per ordinary share. Payment requires shareholder approval at an extraordinary general meeting scheduled November 30, 2026, with disbursement expected to begin December 18 and complete by December 30, 2026, to holders of record October 30, 2026, including American depositary receipt holders. No advisor or premium terms were named; the event is a routine capital return, with the EGM approval and FX/timing as watch items.
